Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Introduction
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
 Your Role And Responsibilities
 As an Application Consultant specializing in Mainframe Modernization, you will leverage your technical expertise to drive strategic initiatives and lead teams in implementing mainframe modernization strategies. You will play a key role in supporting the migration of mainframe applications to cloud platforms.
 Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include
 Technical Leadership: Provide hands-on technical guidance and mentorship to teams implementing in-place mainframe modernization and migration strategies.
 Strategy Development: Develop and implement mainframe modernization roadmaps, aligning with organizational goals and objectives.
 Cloud Migration Support: Support the migration of mainframe applications to z-cloud and other cloud platforms from a mainframe perspective.
 Team Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of mainframe modernization initiatives with existing systems and processes.
 Solution Delivery: Deliver high-quality solutions that meet business requirements, leveraging expertise in mainframe and mainframe modernization concepts and technologies.
 Preferred Education
 Bachelor's Degree
 Required Technical And Professional Expertise
 Mainframe Modernization Expertise: Deep expertise in a wide range of concepts and technologies associated with Mainframe and Mainframe Modernization, including in-place modernization and migration of mainframe applications to cloud platforms.
 Technical Leadership Experience: Experience with technically leading and mentoring teams to implement mainframe modernization strategies and roadmaps.
 Cloud Migration Knowledge: Experience with supporting the migration of mainframe applications to z-cloud and other cloud platforms from a mainframe perspective.
 Mainframe Technology Proficiency: Applied knowledge of mainframe technologies, including the ability to develop and implement mainframe modernization roadmaps.
 Cross-Platform Understanding: Experience with integrating mainframe modernization initiatives with existing systems and processes, including collaboration with cross-functional teams.
 Preferred Technical And Professional Experience
 Mainframe Architecture Knowledge: Deep understanding of mainframe architecture and its components, including the ability to design and implement modernization strategies.
 Cloud Computing Expertise: Experience with cloud computing platforms, including z-cloud, and knowledge of migrating mainframe applications to these platforms.
 IT Service Management: Familiarity with IT service management principles and practices, including the ability to integrate mainframe modernization initiatives with existing systems and processes.
